About Crunchyroll
Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
About the role
In the role of Social Media Manager, UCANZ, you will report to the Senior Manager, Community, UCANZ.
We are considering applicants for the locations of Los Angeles or Dallas.
We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly adaptable 
Social Media Manager, UCANZ,
 to help lead our English-language UCANZ social media presence and support a broad range of social initiatives across announcements, community engagement, priority titles, audience development, and integrated marketing.
You will serve as a social media generalist, taking ownership of key workstreams while flexing across the team’s priorities as business and resourcing needs evolve. You will help shape social strategy and programming, lead cross-functional initiatives, develop audience-first content, and strengthen our engagement and community building among Crunchyroll fans. You will use fan conversation, trends, sentiment, and platform behavior to identify opportunities for meaningful engagement and inform our broader social strategy.
A key focus of this role will be identifying opportunities to reach and grow priority audience segments across UCANZ by leveraging audience insights, platform discovery, community partnerships, and culturally relevant content strategies.
You will also help scale the team through agency and external support, identifying where partners can add capacity or specialized expertise. You will help define agency needs and scopes, onboard and brief partners effectively, establish clear workflows and expectations, and ensure external teams are set up to deliver high-quality work.
You will be combining strong social and creative instincts with a community-first mindset and operational leadership. You understand fandom culture, know how to create meaningful connections between brands and fans, and can translate both audience insights and business priorities into compelling social ideas. You are equally comfortable developing content and engagement strategies, leading agency partners, collaborating across teams, and building the processes needed to execute effectively at scale.
Core Areas of Responsibility
Strategically shape social programming and the editorial calendar, identifying opportunities informed by fan insights, cultural and platform trends, performance, and business priorities.
Develop audience-first social concepts, campaigns, and platform-native content that bring Crunchyroll’s titles, brand, partnerships, and key initiatives to life for fans.
Develop organic social strategies to reach and grow priority audience segments across UCANZ to support broader membership growth objectives.
Lead community management and engagement strategy, identifying opportunities to participate in fan conversation, deepen engagement, and build stronger connections with Crunchyroll’s community.
Lead social support for assigned cross-functional initiatives, partnering with teams across Crunchyroll to translate broader marketing and business objectives into effective social strategies and executions.
Identify where agency or external support can add capacity or specialized expertise across content, community management, publishing, and social operations.
Oversee operational workflows across Social, agency partners, Brand Management, and licensors, helping ensure content approvals are efficiently routed, tracked, documented, and escalated when needed.
Use social performance and audience insights to evaluate effectiveness, identify learnings, and continually optimize social and community strategies.
Provide leadership and flexible coverage across social workstreams during major launches, tentpoles, high-volume periods, and shifting team priorities.
About You
We get excited about candidates, like you, because...
5+ years of experience in social media, community, digital marketing, or a related field in the entertainment or another fandom-driven brand.
Experience working with entertainment IPs.
Experience developing social media strategy using strong creative and editorial instincts across content, programming, community engagement, and campaigns.
Experience developing organic social strategies to reach and grow distinct audience segments, with an understanding of platform discovery, content distribution, and community engagement.
Strong understanding of fandom and online communities and know how to turn fan conversation, trends, and audience behavior into engaging social opportunities.
Experience translating broader brand and business objectives into audience-first social strategies and executions while effectively navigating cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience working with agencies and external partners, from identifying support needs and developing briefs to onboarding and providing strategic direction.
Experience using performance insights to make decisions while managing multiple priorities, stakeholders, and approval processes.
About the Team
Crunchyroll's Community UCANZ team manages our social media, creative, events, influencer activations, and more! The social media team oversees one of the entertainment industry's largest social media networks, with millions of followers across every major platform and growth beyond industry standards.

Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

About The Role
As the Senior Manager, Title Management, you will manage the day-to-day Title Management function within Global Operations, serving as an operational control point for Crunchyroll’s titles from early commitment through launch readiness.
You will implement and continuously improve a consistent title-management approach across schedules, source-material availability, localization, marketing dependencies, and downstream delivery milestones. The Senior Manager ensures that global and regional teams operate from a reliable title plan, understand current risks and priorities, and have clear ownership of required actions.
You will also connect Crunchyroll’s global operating teams with anime licensors and content partners in Japan. You will be building trusted working relationships with licensors, studios, production committees, and other partners to improve visibility into timing, source materials, and schedule changes. You will help translate partner constraints and updates into clear operational plans for global teams.
The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in title and content operations with sound judgment, cultural fluency, and disciplined execution. You will be responsible for managing launch-readiness activities, facilitating timely escalation and decision-making, and helping teams address issues before they become launch disruptions.
While you would not own content acquisition strategy, rights negotiations, creative strategy, localization execution, or final launch decisions, this is a critical role for owning the operational coordination, readiness visibility, and issue management practices that connect these functions.
Core Areas of Responsibility
Title Management Leadership & Control Tower
: lead the day-to-day Title Management function and establish a clear operating model for priority titles; assign accountable operational ownership, define readiness standards and review cadences, set performance expectations, and build a high-performing team that can coordinate complex title launches across regions and functions.
Authoritative Title Plan & Readiness
: own the single title-level operational plan that brings together contractual availability, release timing, expected source and marketing materials, localization milestones, downstream delivery requirements, and critical dependencies; ensure changes are synchronized quickly and that competing trackers or conflicting schedule assumptions are eliminated.
Anime Licensor & Content Partner Partnership
: build and maintain trusted working relationships with anime licensors, studios, production committees, and other content partners in Japan; establish effective communication around release timing, source-material availability, changes, exceptions, and delivery expectations; represent Crunchyroll operational needs with credibility and cultural awareness while translating partner realities into actionable plans for global teams.
Cross-Functional Title Coordination
: partner closely with Rights & Scheduling, Metadata, Asset Management, Global Localization, Integrated Planning, Marketing, Distribution Operations, Regional teams, and other stakeholders to maintain end-to-end title visibility; clarify handoffs, ownership, readiness criteria, and response expectations so each issue has an accountable destination and downstream teams can plan with confidence.
Risk, Escalation & Scenario Management
: identify missing materials, schedule volatility, conflicting dates, readiness gaps, and downstream dependencies early; establish clear escalation pathways and response expectations; use scenario planning for high-risk titles, communicate operational impact rapidly, and drive timely decisions without allowing the control tower to become a passive reporting layer.
Title Management Standards & Continuous Improvement
: standardize readiness dimensions, status definitions, operating reviews, escalation practices, and core planning artifacts; track recurring causes of late or incomplete materials and schedule changes; partner with Operations and Process Transformation on systemic issues and retire redundant trackers where one authoritative plan can replace them.
Outcomes, Team Capability & Operational Excellence
: track readiness accuracy, schedule adherence, late-material frequency, downstream surprises, escalation resolution, and planning quality; use results to improve predictability, coach the team, strengthen partner-facing practices, and raise operational discipline across the title lifecycle.
In the role of Senior Manager, Title Management, you will report to the Senior Director, Global Operations.
We are considering applicants for the location of Tokyo, Japan.
About You
We get excited about candidates, like you, because...
8+ years of professional experience in title management, content operations, content supply chain, localization operations, media operations, anime distribution, or a related field, coordinating complex global title or release workflows.
3+ years of people leadership, team lead, or comparable experience directing the work of content operations professionals.
Native to Business-level Japanese and English skills (speaking, reading, and writing), with the ability to operate effectively in Japanese business settings and communicate clearly with global English-speaking stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience working directly with Japanese anime licensors, studios, production committees, rights holders, or other content partners.
Deep understanding of the end-to-end title lifecycle, including rights and scheduling, source and marketing materials, asset readiness, metadata, localization, release planning, and distribution dependencies.
Experience effectively managing schedule volatility, competing priorities, sensitive partner relationships, and high-visibility launches in a fast-moving global environment.
Experience working in a globally matrixed organization.

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

MARKETING
What We Do
We deliver the most innovative gaming experiences possible to players around the world. Whether through community outreach, world-class events, or partnership integrations, the Epic Games Publishing and Marketing teams seek to surprise players with new experiences every time they drop in to play.
What You'll Do
Epic Games is seeking a highly strategic, culturally fluent, and operationally rigorous Influencer Marketing Director to lead creator and talent partnerships across Fortnite. This role will shape how creators, streamers, athletes, musicians, entertainers, and their communities connect with Fortnite through major launches, live-service moments, partnerships, and creator campaigns.

Develop and lead creator and influencer strategies tied to Fortnite launches, partnerships, live-service beats, and major campaigns
Translate brand and business objectives into measurable creator programs that drive audience engagement, conversation, and commercial impact

Lead high-profile creator and talent integrations from planning through execution, including negotiations, hospitality, experiential activations, and content coordination
Present creator strategies, talent recommendations, and campaign plans clearly and concisely to senior leadership
Partner cross-functionally across Paid Media, Brand Marketing, Competitive, IP Partnerships teams and external partners to deliver cohesive global campaigns
Manage agency partners and oversee campaign execution to ensure work meets Epic’s creative, operational, and business standards
Operate effectively across multiple high-visibility initiatives simultaneously while navigating compressed timelines, shifting priorities, and fast-moving launch environments
What we're looking for
8+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, talent relations, or cultural marketing within gaming, entertainment, sports, music, or adjacent industries
Deep understanding of Fortnite, gaming creators, livestream culture, and the broader creator ecosystem across Twitch, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X
Proven experience managing high-profile creator or celebrity partnerships, including negotiations, experiential activations, hospitality, and complex partner coordination
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to deliver concise strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders
Experience operating effectively in fast-paced, high-volume environments with multiple concurrent launches and evolving priorities
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence teams and stakeholders within highly matrixed organizations
Experience managing agency partners, external vendors, and regional campaign execution across global markets
Demonstrated operational rigor, sound judgment, and attention to detail, with the ability to balance creative thinking and business impact

Strong product management skills and ability to both adjust processes to support existing and new development frameworks as well as mentoring others in good product management practices

AI adoption and process change: Lead the charge through a revolutionary period in game development, helping the team adopt AI where it makes a real difference, and evolve our production practices as the technology matures

Proven ability to establish production methodologies and standards that drive adoption across teams and the broader organization
Strong people leader who builds effective teams, structures, and empowers others through delegation, while being able to grow a production organisation and protect team health as the slate scales
Calm, low-ego and empathetic leader who builds trust across teams, executives and external partners, navigating ambiguity and complex challenges with clarity, sound judgment and strong communication

Comfortable collaborating closely with teams and partners across the UK and US time zones

当社では、クリエイターらしい、個性豊かな社員が多く働いています。当社のゲーム開発部門は複数の制作部で構成されていますが、賑やかでコミュニケーションが活発な部署もあれば、個々が集中して業務に取り組む落ち着いた部署もあります。面接/面談の中でお話を伺いながら、あなたのスキルや個性が活かせるよう最適な人員配置を検討します。

概要
当社は創業48年のゲーム会社。自社オリジナルタイトルの開発・リリースを行うパブリッシャーでありながら、時には大規模タイトルの開発を行うディベロッパーとしての顔も持っています。更に家庭用ゲーム機からスマホゲームまであらゆるフォーマットのゲーム開発経験があり、テーブルゲームから本格RPG、シミュレーションゲームまでジャンルも幅広く展開中。そのため、社員が希望するキャリアを築きやすい環境となっています。
社員が安心して働ける環境の整備に努め、「フレックスタイム制」を導入。社員が心身共に健康で生活できるように、各種制度でバックアップしています。月平均の残業時間も11時間未満と一般的な会社と比較しても短く、働き心地の良い会社です。一度当社を離れても戻ってくる「出戻り社員」も珍しくありません。

老舗の会社でありながら、社員の「やりたい」を応援するベンチャーのような風土があります。年に一度、職種や年次を問わず社員全員が参加可能な企画コンペを開催しており、若手社員の企画が採用された実績もあります。このような全社的な企画に留まらず、日々の仕事の中でも社員が新たな挑戦をする際には、快く背中を押してもらえる環境です。

受託開発と自社タイトルの開発をバランス良く手掛けることで、経営の安定性と社員のチャレンジを後押しする社風を両立。福利厚生も手厚く、社員が安心して働ける環境を整えております。

縦割りの組織ではないため、幅広い業務にチャレンジし、各分野のプロフェッショナルとしてスキルを磨くことができます。会社としても、書籍購入補助や各種セミナーの受講費用の全額負担など、社員が望むスキルアップができるよう努めています。

社員が希望するワークライフバランスを実現するため、フレックス制度を導入し柔軟な働き方を可能としています。そのほか、パパママ育休・時短勤務制度など、それぞれの事情に合わせて働きやすい環境づくりを叶える各種制度・福利厚生の土台があります。
④社員の意見は大歓迎です！フラットな組織
当社の社員からよく上がる会社の魅力の一つとして、「風通しがよく意見が言いやすい」という点があります。年次や立場に関わらず、社員の意見を尊重する風土があり、若手からベテランの社員まで一丸となって共通の目標＝「際立ったものをつくる」ことを目指しています。
